query: How do reasons for visit relate to urgency and visit duration across department and age group?

per_column.name: visit_type
per_column.rationale: Clear, well-separated categories (acute, chronic, preventive, emergency, etc.) that can be grouped and compared against visit duration and urgency; interpretable and informative.

per_column.name: primary_clinical_category
per_column.rationale: Meaningful clinical domains (cardiovascular, musculoskeletal, etc.) enable segmentation; slightly fragmented but still interpretable and useful for exploring duration differences.

per_column.name: symptom_acuity
per_column.rationale: Ordered severity scale (asymptomatic through life_threatening) is highly interpretable and directly relatable to urgency and duration.

per_column.name: condition_complexity
per_column.rationale: Well-separated categories describing condition state; supports interpretable comparison against duration.

per_column.name: injury_mechanism
per_column.rationale: Interpretable mechanism categories that can be segmented on, though it is nearly duplicated by injury_or_illness_mechanism.

per_column.name: diagnostic_workup_intensity
per_column.rationale: Ordered intensity levels are interpretable and plausibly co-vary with duration; the large NULL fraction (~40%) weakens comparison but categories remain meaningful.

per_column.name: treatment_intensity
per_column.rationale: Distinct escalating treatment categories that segment cleanly and relate strongly to visit duration.

per_column.name: disposition_signal
per_column.rationale: Clear discharge/admission outcome categories; interpretable and associational with duration and urgency.

per_column.name: patient_age_proxy
per_column.rationale: Essentially restates the existing age_group focus dimension; adds no new external relationship and is heavily dominated by 'adult' (near-constant).

per_column.name: injury_or_illness_mechanism
per_column.rationale: Near-duplicate of injury_mechanism with almost identical value distribution; redundant and adds no distinct relationship.

judge.rationale: The set is largely strong for EDA: most added columns are external, interpretable categorical variables with well-separated levels (visit_type, symptom_acuity, treatment_intensity, disposition_signal, condition_complexity, clinical_category) that can be grouped and compared against visit_duration_min alongside urgency, department, and age group. Weaknesses lower the score: patient_age_proxy merely restates the existing age_group dimension, and injury_or_illness_mechanism is a near-exact duplicate of injury_mechanism, adding redundancy rather than new relationships; diagnostic_workup_intensity is diluted by a large NULL share. Overall the columns realise the exploratory-relationship claim well but not fully due to redundancy and restatement.
